name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2

requirements.title: PlayStation PC SDK runtime (installed by Steam's installscript on Windows)

notes: Needs AVX2 and F16C: Rosetta hides them unless ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1 (set for you).
Steam does not run its installscript under Wine; the PlayStation PC SDK runtime MSIs are installed on the first launch.
Uses DirectStorage with GPU GDeflate decompression, provided by the layer (gdeflate=1, the default).
Status: boots and renders the first splash; progress past it is still being worked on.
